material_findings.finding: Frozen sanity language says plan block content <=96 model tokens, but producer contract accepts only when the full serialized <PLAN>...</PLAN> text is <=96. Before any model call, define the limit explicitly on the inner plan content and make producer/validator semantics match, or prospectively justify that content means the full serialized block. Avoid silently narrowing qualification.

UNRELATED_PLAN must come from the fixed qualified set, while required control constructibility itself can disqualify a family. Current contract does not specify whether donors are recomputed after disqualification, leaving outcome-dependent donor-set ambiguity. Freeze a deterministic simultaneous fixed-point rule before engineering/model calls.
